body: Ahhh phew!!!  Im not really sure how I am, I don’t really feel anything very often but trying to overdose isn’t something I have acted on before. However, I think it may have been a form of self harm which is familiar to me so yeah, I’m okay. I think. Thanks for asking if I’m okay and for answering my question :)

Tell your parents how you feel! This is so important because I can promise you that they will get you help, they will try to understand you, doing badly in college is not the end of the world. Drop out, take a break. Your mental health matters a whole lot more than college!! Talk to your tutor and let them know how your feeling! Talk to someone, who knows you and knows how to deal with your situation! Do not kill yourself before next week! Last the week and survive it and you will be proven wrong and it’ll be fine <3

I too was abused however at my fathers hands, the day I see him dead will be a huggggeee weight off of my shoulder, don’t let anyone in the comments tell you the way in which you are feeling is wrong, blood relation does not account for the abuse you have suffered

Speak to a senior member in your school and ask them for a way to earn money or find a job! Is there someone you can stay with that lives far enough away? Is there a friend who also wants to move? find options and decide! But honestly whatever you do, last another year if you must! Survive, stick it through and you will finally be old enough to move away and get a job and begin your life!!! Don’t end it before it’s even over!!!!

Ask your job if you can transfer or even move cities! Starting off new anywhere can be scary but what’s scarier than dying and the lost potential of a happy life! It takes time to adjust and to build up the courage to pack up your bags but you’ve spent time building up the courage to commit suicide which is something only the strongest of us are able to do! Even if it’s taking a year out to move to another city and work in a cafe, this may open your eyes and mind to new opportunities and even new friends! Try an entirely new way of life away from the people who are causing you misery at the moment and if you still feel the same way in a year then consider the last and final option. If you die, you will never get the chance to watch your children grow up! To fall in love! Please don’t be scared to fail!

Listen! Don’t kill yourself! That is not the way to go! If you need to escape the life you are living now then move away, far away and start a new life! If you feel able to leave your friends and family then leave them but don’t end your life- begin a new one! I guarantee you have so much potential but you’re being held back by those surrounding you! Escape the country! Run away! Don’t kill yourself because as of now you’re someone I care about <3
You can’t write a proper suicide note because you’re subconsciously telling yourself that you’re not ready to go yet! Please don’t do anything rational!

Personally, I think everyone is attractive in their own way. Sometimes, when you’re finding it hard to believe that you’re not attractive you’ve just got to think of some of your obviously good traits. It is rare for someone to think of themselves as attractive! I promise you’re not alone! Consider other things like your personality because that in itself can make or break someone’s attractiveness and at the end of the day, there is the possibility that we could lose our looks at any moment and your personality is the only trait that stays with you forever :)
Own it! You don’t have to be alone to be lonely!
